name: RIF US Dollar
oneLiner: USDRIF is RIF On Chain's dollar token on Rootstock, minted against RIF token collateral via overcollateralized CDP-style positions.
collateral: RIF tokens and DOC (Dollar on Chain) V3 multi-collateral reserves.
pegMechanism: USDRIF is minted through RIF on Chain using RIF and DOC V3 collateral, with the peg supported by a multi-collateral CDP/redemption design rather than a fiat reserve account.

oracleRisk.summary: RIF on Chain uses a replaceable RIF/USD PriceProvider and published Medianizer for one global RIF reserve bucket; no stronger failover tier is documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDRIF is minted and redeemed against the single C0 RIF reserve bucket, whose global coverage and system states use one RIF/USD price path. The protocol has no borrower-specific collateral positions or market-specific oracle and liquidation branches; below its final coverage threshold it enters one irreversible system-wide liquidation state.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata or audit notes identify direct seizure, freeze, blacklist, privileged burn, proxy-upgrade, or chain-governance intervention authority despite decentralized governance labeling.

reserves.name: RIF collateral locked in RIF On Chain smart contracts

mintAuthority.summary: USDRIF is minted by users against overcollateralized RIF (and, since V3, DOC) collateral via the RIF On Chain (Money on Chain) protocol on Rootstock; on-chain governance tunes parameters and upgrades contracts through the MoC Governor/Changer pattern on upgradeable proxies.

controls.label: RIF On Chain (MoC) mint/redeem contracts
controls.capDescription: Users mint USDRIF by depositing RIF/DOC collateral subject to the protocol's overcollateralization rules; the V3 Multi-Collateral Guard manages collateral across buckets.
controls.evidence: RIF On Chain docs/Rootstock coverage describe users minting USDRIF against RIF collateral via the MoC-architecture dApp; V3 added DOC as second collateral and a Multi-Collateral Guard, preserving the core mint/redeem logic.

controls.label: MoC Governor / Changer governance
controls.evidence: RIF On Chain uses the Money on Chain Governor/Changer pattern: parameter changes and proxy upgrades are executed on-chain via changer contracts after community votes (e.g., V2.0 and V3 upgrades were governance-executed proxy upgrades).

review.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202: USDRIF token 0x3a15461d governor() selector (0x0c340a24) returned Governor proxy 0x3b8853df65afbd94853e6d77ee0ab5590f41bb08 (confirmed as a contract). Governor proxy EIP-1967 admin = ProxyAdmin 0x1a1824f39d79937dcb80c9d9938ae77e431c2def; ProxyAdmin storage slot 0 (owner) = 0x131564703310a294c1bfdc09d10ec0659f18e253 (also a proxy with ProxyAdmin = 0x1a1824, circular). Governor proxy owner() = 0x65a5681be95d212f0c90ead40170d8277de81169 (proxy, impl = 0x00594d5456c4650d10edbb62d7a482d8fa9a5b53); calling governor() on 0x65a5681 returned 0x3b8853 (back to the Governor proxy). USDRIF token EIP-1967 implementation = 0x6d1bb87856a2b2351d87ba5772a93dc911325af9. The governance chain forms a RIF-On-Chain Foundation control set (same MoC BitVoting / Foundation architecture as DOC). Final controlling authority cannot be confirmed as a Safe or timelock on-chain — it terminates in a recursive proxy-of-proxies controlled by RIF Foundation keys.
unresolvedQuestions: The RIF On Chain Governor proxy control chain terminates in a recursive proxy set (0x65a5681 ↔ 0x3b8853 ↔ 0x131564 ↔ 0x1a1824); the final human-controlled authority (multisig threshold/keyholders) is not enumerable from on-chain state — characteristic of MoC Foundation BitVoting; Arbitrum bridge mint authority also unresolved.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDRIF is native to Rootstock (a RIF/DOC-collateralized CDP stablecoin launched Sep 2023, contract 0x3a15461d..., a plain ERC-20 with no cross-chain code). Its sole cross-chain supply path is a LayerZero OFT route: a dedicated OFT Adapter (lockbox) on Rootstock (0xb2ee5502...) locks native USDRIF and a burn/mint OFT representation (the verified "MyOFT" contract 0x8eef5ed..., Endpoint V2) is minted on Arbitrum. On-chain checks confirm the lockbox (adapter token()=native USDRIF, approvalRequired=true) holds ~61,268 USDRIF locked, matching the Arbitrum OFT supply 1:1, and the OFT is peered only to Rootstock (EID 30333). Because the durable route is a third-party LayerZero OFT Adapter/lockbox control surface, it is classified external-lock-mint.

protocols.name: LayerZero OFT (Arbitrum MyOFT contract)
protocols.note: Verified Arbitrum contract named MyOFT, inherits LayerZero OFT standard, uses ILayerZeroEndpointV2 with lzSend/lzReceive. Mint/burn OFT representation on the destination chain.

protocols.name: Rootstock LayerZero/Stargate OFT Adapter integration
protocols.note: Rootstock joined LayerZero (Mar 2025); native Rootstock assets go multichain via the OFT (Adapter/Lockbox) standard with Stargate as the first dApp. Home chain locks, destination mints.
